description: Hand-curated threshold type overrides. MACPAC state_standards rows default to estimated_standard unless listed here or in staffing_compliance_thresholds.

overrides.short_caveat: Long-standing federal requirement; often cited near 0.3 HPRD for a typical 100-bed facility.
overrides.methodology_caveat: Federal regulation requires licensed nurse coverage and an RN director of nursing onsite; PBJ320 may display approximate HPRD equivalents for context.

overrides.public_label: CMS 2001 expert panel recommendation (total direct care)
overrides.short_caveat: Influential research benchmark, not a binding federal rule.
overrides.methodology_caveat: CMS convened an expert panel in 2001; facilities are not required to meet 4.1 HPRD.

overrides.short_caveat: Proposed federal minimum staffing rule; numeric standards were rescinded and are not enforced.
overrides.methodology_caveat: Courts vacated key portions and Congress imposed a moratorium; facilities remain subject to pre-2024 federal requirements.

overrides.public_label: CT total nursing HPRD daily screen
overrides.short_caveat: MACPAC estimated total staffing requirement used for PBJ daily screening.
overrides.methodology_caveat: Connecticut law may reference direct-care hour minimums separately. PBJ320 applies this benchmark to total reported nursing HPRD.
overrides.source_url_or_note: MACPAC state staffing compendium (2022); CT Public Act direct-care minimums
